usage: music-tagger place [-h] [--root ROOT] [--artist-dir ARTIST_DIR]
                          [--album-dir ALBUM_DIR] [--merge] [--dry-run]
                          [--log LOG | --no-log]
                          path

Copy a finished album into the library with SHA-256 verification. Afterward,
removes the copied source files when it is a temp staging directory; anything
it did not copy is kept.

positional arguments:
  path                  Album directory to copy.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Library root (default: /mnt/synology/media/music).
  --artist-dir ARTIST_DIR
                        Override the artist directory name.
  --album-dir ALBUM_DIR
                        Override the album directory name.
  --merge               Allow copying into an existing album directory.
                        Existing files are kept.
  --dry-run             Show the destination and files without copying.
  --log LOG             Append changes to this log file (default:
                        $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                        tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log              Do not write the change log.
